notes.title: End of the Journey for DunJumb
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

After much reflection, I’ve decided to remove DunJumb from Steam in the coming days.

The game has gradually seen less and less activity over time, and while that’s always tough to face as a developer, I’m incredibly grateful for the journey this project has taken me on. Creating DunJumb and seeing people from around the world play it, enjoy it, and share their feedback has been truly meaningful to me.

To everyone who gave the game a shot — thank you. Whether you played for 10 minutes or 10 hours, your presence meant a lot.

I encourage anyone who purchased the game to request a refund via Steam Support, as DunJumb unfortunately didn’t live up to the promises I had hoped to deliver.

Thank you again for being a part of DunJumb’s story. I wish you the very best with whatever comes next, and perhaps we’ll cross paths again in a future project.

notes.title: The DunJumb Experience ! (Experimental Mode)
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers !

It's been a while since I wanted to test different things with my game, notably through this experimental mode.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44786080/cd6a54440d3cd70b91500346218936bfcbc553d8.png[/img]

The idea is that you gain cards that are composed of a bonus and a malus that will modify your games, and you can call on the witch or the blacksmith to alter these cards, and thus create the best possible cards for your adventure!

This version is currently only playable in the browser on the itch.io website, but I may soon add it to the steam client if I see the feedback is positive.

Here's the link for the test: https://yelarch.itch.io/dunjumb-experience

Don't hesitate to share your feedback on the game's discord, and see you soon in DunJumb!

Link to the discord : https://discord.com/invite/aV5cfpj9RZ

notes.title: The Rise Of Chaos Update
notes.notes:
Hello my fellow adventurers ! DunJumb is back !

Something terrible happened to DunJumb: Chaos has taken it hostage ! Not even the great investor could stop him !
He's invited himself into the adventure and brought his darkness with him. Will you be able to take advantage of it or will you sink into fear? Only you are master of your destiny...

Today start the Rise of Chaos Event in DunJumb ! Connect before march to automatically unlock [b]Chaos, the new character[/b] !
Enjoy the new weapon and his new spell ! Will you be able to contain its power ?

[previewyoutube=2RMcEUNwp-E;full][/previewyoutube]
With this you will find a new skin for Gandilf, and a new starter item in the investor's lair !

I'm really looking forward to get your feedbacks so don't hesitate to join the new discord for any questions or suggestions !
